title: Explain closes only the statement it created, never the shared OLAP connection other users' queries run on

criteria.given: CellExplainService captures the SQL for a cell on the connection it borrows from the connection manager's cache
criteria.then: it closes the statement and cellset it created and does not close the borrowed connection, on success or failure

criteria.given: two sessions explain cells while a third runs ordinary queries on the same datasource
criteria.then: every ordinary query succeeds (launcher integration test ExplainKeepsSharedConnectionIT ships)

criteria.given: any production method under saiku-core (package-private included) that binds a variable to getNativeConnection(...) or getOlapConnection(...)
criteria.then: it does not close that variable (close(), closeQuietly, try-with-resources), and every such call sits in a method the check examined; connections passed on unbound, or closed through another method, are outside the check
CellExplainServiceTest asserts the connection stays open and the statement and cellset are closed
